v008/v009, answering the v007 review: every podium ring now shares one list of polar angles that includes each opening's exact edges. F1: fins continue above and below the ribbon window, with slats across it. F2: a closed upper storey runs right round behind the band (slab at 6.4 m, ceiling at 10.1 m, an inner wall 9 m in, cross walls), and the ribbon has jambs at both ends. F3: the curtain wall is cut at both entrances, where glazed leaves of 1.2 m fill the bays under a head and transom light, with stiles at every joint; the service door is recessed 0.15 m in a framed opening; the roof entrance is a portal cut into the foot of the west shell, with jambs, a head, a glazed screen and a lobby with the head of a stair going down. P2s: three doors from the foyer into the hall drum (F11), steps and a guard bringing the path up to the lip (F6), a timber-brown stage (F7), domed planting (F8), the guard stands on the coping (F10). v009 splits the door bays into equal leaves.
findings: Plan follows the roof view: rounded podium 88 by 64.4 m (superellipse, n 3.3); oculus 23.8 by 18.8 m centred 11.4 m east and 1.7 m south of the podium centre; west shell from the north notch round the west and south; east shell from the south-east round the east to the notch; radial notch at the north with the west shell 1.4 m higher.

Oblique: the fitted camera (31 px RMS over 39 traced podium points) shows the podium band, recessed glazing, roof loop, the two rims meeting in a V at the back, the ring under the west shell and the hall through the oculus.
Heights: glazed ground floor 6.0 m, finned band to 11.2 m, roof garden 10.6 m, lip 12.4 m, west shell rim peak 23.6 m, east shell 21.6 m.

Openings: the curtain wall is set 1.0 m back under the band, with mullions about every 4.8 m, a transom at 3.4 m, a sill and a foyer behind it. Main doors: six glazed 1.2 m leaves filling the cut bay at the south centre; four at the east; a recessed service door in an opaque back-of-house at the north-east. Three doors lead from the foyer into the hall drum.
Ribbon window in the band on the west end, set in a 0.35 m reveal with sill and head returns and rooms behind it.
Auditorium seen through the oculus: 11 raked tiers with seat strips facing an east stage, choir terraces, two balcony rings and vertical acoustic panels; about 340 stalls seats.

Roof garden: a winding loop midway between the shells and the guard, a south-west walk, spurs to the oculus lip and the west shell entrance, 2,600 low mounds in meadow and green drifts with pale flower clumps.
